tts.style: Read the following as an upbeat, confident product-demo narrator at a brisk, natural conversational pace of about 160 words per minute: clear and warm, with short pauses only at full stops. Speak only the text after this line.

beats.narration: In March, your team ruled out SMS codes for two-factor sign-in. In November, someone opens a story to add them anyway.
beats.caption: In March, your team ruled out SMS codes for two-factor sign-in. In November, someone opens a story to add them anyway.

beats.narration: Precedent catches it, wherever the work happens.
beats.caption: Precedent catches it, wherever the work happens.

beats.narration: Here's that story. Before anyone opens it, the panel says one conflict: A.D.R. seven chose passkeys over SMS, because SIM-swap attacks make SMS unsafe. Teamwork Graph shows who owns it.
beats.caption: Here's that story. Before anyone opens it, the panel says 1 conflict: ADR-007 chose passkeys over SMS, because SIM-swap attacks make SMS unsafe. Teamwork Graph shows who owns it.

beats.narration: One click asks the Precedent agent in Rovo, which explains it and suggests what to do next.
beats.caption: One click asks the Precedent agent in Rovo, which explains it and suggests what to do next.

beats.narration: If the team really wants SMS now, record a decision that reverses A.D.R. seven, right from the story. Precedent shows what it understood, the conflict clears everywhere, and the history stays.
beats.caption: If the team really wants SMS now, record a decision that reverses ADR-007, right from the story. Precedent shows what it understood, the conflict clears everywhere, and the history stays.

beats.narration: RFCs get checked while they're written: this one proposes texting recovery codes, and the byline flags it.
beats.caption: RFCs get checked while they're written: this one proposes texting recovery codes, and the byline flags it.

beats.narration: The register keeps every decision. Work at risk lists open work that contradicts one, and one click asks the owner.
beats.caption: The register keeps every decision. Work at risk lists open work that contradicts one, and one click asks the owner.

beats.narration: Coding agents ask too. Over MCP, Claude checks the plan, finds A.D.R. seven, and declines to build the SMS fallback, proposing recovery codes instead.
beats.caption: Coding agents ask too. Over MCP, Claude checks the plan, finds ADR-007, and declines to build the SMS fallback, proposing recovery codes instead.

beats.narration: There's no language model inside the app: checks are fast and free, and the reasoning happens in Rovo.
beats.caption: There's no language model inside the app: checks are fast and free, and the reasoning happens in Rovo.

beats.narration: Every answer is filtered to what the person asking can already open, even over MCP. Precedent stores no personal data, and it runs entirely on Atlassian's platform.
beats.caption: Every answer is filtered to what the person asking can already open, even over MCP. Precedent stores no personal data, and it runs entirely on Atlassian's platform.

beats.narration: Your team already decided. Precedent makes sure you remember, before you ship.
beats.caption: Your team already decided. Precedent makes sure you remember, before you ship.
